description:
You are a Marketing Manager auditing the 'Books to Scrape' website for SERP display issues. Your goal is to identify page titles that are too long and will be truncated in Google search results (exceeding 568 pixels). 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider and crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
2. Wait for the crawl to complete (approx. 1000 pages).
3. Go to the 'Page Titles' tab and review the 'Title 1 Pixel Width' column.
4. Export the Page Titles data to a CSV file at '~/Documents/SEO/exports/page_titles_serp.csv'.
5. Analyze the data and write a remediation report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/title_truncation_report.txt'.

The report must include:
- Total number of pages crawled
- Number of titles exceeding 568 pixels
- Percentage of affected pages
- A list of at least 5 specific truncated page titles (with their pixel widths)
- Specific recommendations for shortening them
